_schema.purpose: Known-vulnerable driver canaries for Cthaeh scoring regression checks.
_schema.binary_policy: Do not commit driver binaries here. Keep only metadata, private corpus paths, or acquisition notes.

fields.version: Optional exact FileVersion/ProductVersion to pin the canary
fields.min_priority: Minimum expected Cthaeh tier when the driver is scored on merit
fields.min_score: Minimum expected raw score when the driver is scored on merit
fields.expected_checks: Optional check IDs expected to appear in findings

canaries.acquisition: Use Jeff's private analyzed sample set or reacquire from the original Samsung package; do not redistribute.
Use Jeff's private analyzed sample set or reacquire from the matching ASUS package; do not redistribute.
Use Jeff's private analyzed sample set or reacquire from the matching MediaTek/OEM package; do not redistribute.
